pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ viharati aggāḷave cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kosiyakārake upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.6: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā amhe upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vakkhanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.7: bahū āvuso kosakārake pacatha, amhākampi dassatha, mayampi icchāma kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kātunti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.8: amhākampi alābhā amhākampi dulladdhaṃ, ye mayaṃ ājīvassa hetu puttadārassa kāraṇā bahū khuddake pāṇake saṅghātaṃ āpādemā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.9: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.10: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.11: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū kosiyakārake upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vakkhanti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.12: bahū āvuso kosakārake pacatha, amhākampi dassatha, mayampi icchāma kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kātunti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.13: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.14: “saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave kosiyakārake upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadetha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.15: bahū āvuso kosakārake pacatha, amhākampi dassatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.19: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā kosiyakārake upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vakkhatha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.20: bahū āvuso kosakārake pacatha, amhākampi dassatha, mayampi icchāma kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kātu”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.22: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:1.23.1: “yo pana bhikkhu kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.1.8: ekenapi kosiyaṃsunā - missetvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.1.10: nissajitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.1.13: “idaṃ me bhante kosiyamissakaṃ santhataṃ kārāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.1: attanā vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.2: attanā vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.3: parehi vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.4: parehi vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.5: aññassatthāya karoti vā kārāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np11:2.2.6: aññena kataṃ paṭilabhitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
